title: Scoundrel's Folly
description: After discovering connections between Goldenglow Estate and Honningbrew Meadery, Mercer Frey sends you to Solitude to interrogate Gulum-Ei, an Argonian dockworker and former Guild contact, about the Thieves Guild's anonymous adversary.

base_facts: A senior member of the Thieves Guild who can provide advice on Guild operations.
Aware of the Guild's recent troubles and the investigation into their anonymous adversary.

SPEAK_TO_MERCER_FREY: Brynjolf can offer optional advice before you head to Solitude to find Gulum-Ei.

base_facts: Guild Master of the Thieves Guild.
Discovered the connection between the Goldenglow Bill of Sale and the Promissory Note from Honningbrew Meadery.

SPEAK_TO_MERCER_FREY: Mercer identified Gulum-Ei as a former Guild contact who may know who is targeting the Guild.
Mercer believes the Guild is being deliberately undermined, not cursed.
RETURN_TO_MERCER: Mercer is upset to learn Karliah is behind the attacks on the Guild.
Mercer deduces Karliah will be at Snow Veil Sanctum and insists on coming along on the next job.
QUEST_COMPLETE: Mercer plans to confront Karliah at Snow Veil Sanctum and insists on accompanying you personally.
Quest completes. Karliah identified as the adversary who murdered Gallus and is targeting Mercer. One piece of Thieves Guild armor is upgraded.

Detailed Walkthrough [ edit ] The Plot Thickens [ edit ] When you next speak to Mercer, he will remark that the symbol found on the Goldenglow Bill of Sale from Goldenglow Estate is the same as the one on the Promissory.
This makes this mission significantly easier to complete for a non-stealthy character, but you will forfeit the payment and you will not have Gulum-Ei as a fence later on.

base_facts: An Argonian dockworker for the East Empire Company in Solitude.
A former contact of the Thieves Guild who used to steal goods for them.

CONFRONT_GULUM_EI: Gulum-Ei is stubborn and refuses to reveal information easily out of fear for his own safety.
Gulum-Ei can be persuaded with high Speech skill, bribed with Firebrand Wine from the Blue Palace, or shadowed.
OBTAIN_INFORMATION: Gulum-Ei was approached by a mysterious angry woman who gave him gold to buy Goldenglow Estate.
The woman's anger was directed specifically at Mercer Frey.
Gulum-Ei gave you Soul Gems as compensation for your effort.
SHADOW_AND_CONFRONT: Gulum-Ei was not fully forthcoming about what he knows.
Gulum-Ei leads through the East Empire Company Warehouse to Brinewater Grotto.
CONFRONT_IN_GROTTO: Gulum-Ei reveals the mysterious woman is Karliah, who murdered the previous Guildmaster Gallus.
If spared, Gulum-Ei offers to act as a fence for stolen goods as repayment.

beats.comment: Player speaks to Mercer Frey and learns about Gulum-Ei and the connection between the two documents.
Player travels to the Winking Skeever and confronts Gulum-Ei, who may require persuasion, bribery via Firebrand Wine, or shadowing.
Player obtains partial information from Gulum-Ei after persuading, bribing with wine, or threatening. Gulum-Ei mentions a mysterious angry woman targeting Mercer.
Player shadows Gulum-Ei through the East Empire Company Warehouse to Brinewater Grotto and confronts him there.
Player returns to Mercer Frey with the confession and learns Karliah is the adversary. Mercer deduces she is at Snow Veil Sanctum.
Quest completes. Karliah identified as the adversary who murdered Gallus and is targeting Mercer. One piece of Thieves Guild armor is upgraded.
